title: Downstream authorization check bypassed
description: Synthetic case: delegated context permits read-only; downstream API receives a write request.
policy_assumptions: Parent and child grants are read-only on resource-A.
The downstream service receives the child identity and must evaluate the effective delegated grant.
No separate write approval or elevation exists.

expected.rationale: A downstream authorization boundary must independently enforce the effective grant.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
